Title: Valid user login with registered credentials
Preconditions: User is on /app/login and logged out
Steps: 1. Enter 'qa@shoplite.test' in Email field. 2. Enter 'Passw0rd!23' in Password field. 3. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: User is authenticated and redirected to /app/products.html.
Actual Result: User is logged in and redirected to /app/products.html.

Title: Login attempt with empty email and password fields
Preconditions: User is on /app/login and logged out
Steps: 1. Leave Email field empty. 2. Leave Password field empty. 3. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: Login is rejected with validation error messages for required fields.
Actual Result: System bypasses authentication and logs the user into /app/products.html.

Title: Mask password again after unchecking 'Show password'
Preconditions: User is on /app/login with 'Passw0rd!23' entered in Password field
Steps: 1. Check 'Show password' checkbox. 2. Uncheck 'Show password' checkbox.
Expected Result: Password field reverts to masked characters after unchecking.
Actual Result: Password remains visible in plain text after unchecking.

Title: Verify user password is not stored in plain text in Local Storage
Steps: 1. Open Browser DevTools (F12). 2. Navigate to Application > Local Storage > https://shoplite-qa.netlify.app.
Expected Result: No plain-text password is stored in browser Local Storage.
Actual Result: Plain-text password ('Passw0rd!23') is stored under key 'sl_last_password'.

Title: Block direct access to protected route (/app/products.html) when logged out
Preconditions: User has clicked 'Logout' and has no active session
Steps: 1. Enter 'https://shoplite-qa.netlify.app/app/products.html' in browser address bar. 2. Press Enter.
Actual Result: Protected page loads directly displaying 'Hi, Guest' in the header.

Title: Load all catalogue products with valid product images
Steps: 1. View all 8 product cards in the catalogue. 2. Check Browser DevTools Console for asset errors.
Expected Result: All 8 product cards display valid images with HTTP 200 status.
Actual Result: 'Vertex Air 13' image fails to load and logs HTTP 404 (/app/images/vertex-air.png).

Title: Disable 'Add to cart' button for out-of-stock product (0 stock)
Steps: 1. Locate 'Vertex Air 13' product card. 2. Attempt to click the action button.
Expected Result: Button displays 'Out of stock' in disabled state and prevents adding to cart.
Actual Result: Button is disabled with label 'Out of stock' and item cannot be added.

Title: Case-insensitive product search using lowercase keyword ('aurora')
Steps: 1. Type 'aurora' in lowercase into the Search input box.
Expected Result: Catalogue filters results case-insensitively and displays 'Aurora 14 Laptop'.
Actual Result: Search is case-sensitive and displays 'No products found for "aurora"'.

Title: Sanitize HTML/JavaScript XSS payload in product search input
Steps: 1. Enter '' in the Search input box.
Expected Result: Search query is escaped and rendered safely as plain text without script execution.
Actual Result: JavaScript executes and triggers an 'XSS' alert pop-up in the browser.

Title: Sort products by 'Price: low to high' in ascending numerical order
Preconditions: User is on /app/products.html with Category set to 'Laptop'
Steps: 1. Select 'Laptop' from Category dropdown. 2. Select 'Price: low to high' from Sort by dropdown.
Expected Result: Products order numerically: Aurora (84999), Vertex Air (99900), Nimbus Pro (129999).
Actual Result: Products sort lexicographically as strings: Nimbus (129999), Aurora (84999), Vertex Air (99900).

Title: Update displayed product count dynamically on category filter
Steps: 1. Select 'Laptop' from Category dropdown (3 matching products). 2. Inspect count label.
Expected Result: Product count label updates to 'Showing 3 of 8 products'.
Actual Result: Product count label remains hardcoded as 'Showing 8 of 8 products'.

Title: Add 1 unit of a product on single 'Add to cart' click
Preconditions: User is on /app/products.html with empty cart (Cart (0))
Steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' once on 'Aurora 14 Laptop'. 2. Navigate to /app/cart.html.
Expected Result: Cart displays 'Aurora 14 Laptop' with Qty = 1 and header shows 'Cart (1)'.
Actual Result: Single click adds Qty = 2 and header displays 'Cart (2)'.

Title: Prevent client-side tampering of product unit price in cart
Preconditions: At least one item is in /app/cart.html
Steps: 1. Click the 'Unit price' field for a cart item. 2. Attempt to modify the price to '0' or '-10'.
Expected Result: Unit price is read-only text and cannot be edited by the user.
Actual Result: Unit price is an editable input field allowing negative prices and negative subtotals.

Title: Reject zero (0) or negative (-1) item quantity in cart
Preconditions: At least one item is in /app/cart.html
Steps: 1. Set 'Qty' input field to '-1'. 2. Observe line total, subtotal, and grand total.
Expected Result: System rejects non-positive quantities (minimum Qty = 1) or removes item cleanly.
Actual Result: System accepts Qty = -1, producing Line total '৳-84,999' and Grand total '৳-91253.925'.

Title: Cap SAVE10 coupon discount at 2,000 BDT for orders above 20,000 BDT
Steps: 1. Enter 'SAVE10' in Coupon code input. 2. Click 'Apply coupon'.
Expected Result: 10% discount (8,499.90 BDT) is capped at 2,000 BDT and Grand total is properly rounded.
Actual Result: Discount is uncapped at '৳8,499.9' and Grand total renders unrounded float '৳82874.02500000001'.

Title: Apply free delivery above 5,000 BDT and 120 BDT delivery fee at or below 5,000 BDT
Preconditions: User is on /app/cart.html with items in cart
Steps: 1. Verify Delivery fee when subtotal > 5,000 BDT. 2. Verify Delivery fee when subtotal <= 5,000 BDT.
Expected Result: Delivery is 'Free' above 5,000 BDT and '120 BDT' at or below 5,000 BDT.
Actual Result: Delivery displays 'Free' above 5,000 BDT and '৳120' when subtotal is <= 5,000 BDT.

Title: Calculate 7.5% VAT accurately on cart subtotal
Preconditions: Cart contains items with Subtotal = 254,998 BDT and Discount = 0 BDT
Steps: 1. Navigate to /app/cart.html. 2. Verify VAT (7.5%) and Grand total values.
Expected Result: VAT equals 19,124.85 BDT and Grand total equals 274,122.85 BDT.
Actual Result: VAT displays '৳19124.85' and Grand total displays '৳274122.85'.

Title: Navigate from cart to checkout page via 'Proceed to checkout'
Preconditions: Cart contains at least one valid product on /app/cart.html
Expected Result: User is navigated to /app/checkout.html with order summary.
